**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 already delivers our full preferred insurance position:

| Playbook requirement | Document (§ 18.1–18.2) |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Exact match |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | ✅ Exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (processes Customer Data) | ✅ Exact match |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ Present, plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ Certificates *and* evidence of coverage on request |

Supporting terms also favor us: coverage runs at Vendor's expense through the term plus one year, policies are primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary, Vendor must give advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and insurance expressly does not limit Vendor's liabilities — which preserves the Section 21 cap and Excluded Claims carve-outs. Additional-insured status is not a playbook requirement, and the non-limitation language is sufficient here.
